name: Trial of the Lake

angles.text: As a druid, you face a test of swiftness and adaptability in Moonglade. The rite of passage honors Keeper Remulos.

aliases: what is trial of the lake
purpose of trial of the lake
faq.answer: The Trial of the Lake tests an initiate's agility and focus in Moonglade. You dive into the cold depths of Lake Elune'ara to retrieve a Shrine Bauble that decays rapidly, then race across the haven to the Shrine of Remulos before its energy dissipates.
faq.q: What is the Trial of the Lake?

faq.answer: The Shrine of Remulos stands in northwestern Moonglade. It honors Keeper Remulos, who guides the Cenarion Circle, and warden Tajarri guards and maintains it.
faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Remulos located?

faq.answer: Tajarri is a trusted warden of Moonglade who tends the Shrine of Remulos. She oversees the Trial of the Lake and welcomes initiates who bring the bauble to honor the shrine.

A Shrine Bauble is a relic found along the bed of Lake Elune'ara. Once taken from the water, it decays rapidly, so its bearer must race to activate it at the Shrine of Remulos as tribute before its energy dissipates.
Keeper Remulos is a revered keeper of the grove who guides the Cenarion Circle in preserving nature and maintaining balance. The shrine in northwestern Moonglade honors his leadership and principles.
faq.q: Why is Keeper Remulos honored at this shrine?

faq.answer: Activating the bauble at the Shrine of Remulos pays tribute to the sacred balance the Cenarion Circle maintains and acknowledges the shrine's lasting spiritual importance in Moonglade.
faq.q: What does offering the bauble at the shrine signify?

sections.body: Moonglade's guardians oversee this rite for initiates. You dive into Lake Elune'ara to find a delicate Shrine Bauble resting along the sunken lakebed. It begins to decay as soon as you disturb it, so you need a sure touch, keen senses, and swift movement to carry it overland before its magic fades.
sections.title: A Test of Dexterity

sections.body: Once you have the bauble, you must hurry to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade. The monument honors Keeper Remulos, who guides the Cenarion Circle in preserving nature and world balance. Activating the bauble there marks its importance to the Circle. Warden Tajarri greets initiates who beat the time limit and the competition.
sections.title: Tribute to the Keeper

summary: In Moonglade, an initiate faces the Trial of the Lake, a timed test of speed and dexterity. You dive into Lake Elune'ara for an unstable Shrine Bauble, then hurry to the Shrine of Remulos before it decays. Success earns Tajarri's recognition and honors the Cenarion Circle's devotion to balance.
attribution: In-game quest text: Trial of the Lake
